assertion_review.independence: The imposed geometric displacement is compared to measured output movement; it is not the output echoed back as its own reference.

assertion_review.assertion: valid, row_present, corrected relative moment zero, field_update 0.1
assertion_review.fails_when: Removing the row or column makes row_present false or the Schur solve nonfinite; restoring the old cell-relative residual with the nonzero 0.25 m target produces the wrong moment and field update.
assertion_review.independence: Expected zero moment and 0.1 field correction are fixed consequences of the synthetic identity matrix and residual, not values returned by the function.

assertion_review.assertion: analytic centroid_gradient agrees with central differences
assertion_review.fails_when: Restoring the old gradient omits centres/total from current derivatives at heights -0.2 and 0.4, disagreeing with numerical derivatives of the corrected centroid.
assertion_review.independence: Central differences independently check the analytic derivative, but both could agree on an incorrect centroid formula; the separate geometric translation test establishes the physical quantity.
